name: MultiAddons Bulk Product & Cart Discount for WooCommerce
author: multiaddons

sections.description:
Best free WooCommerce bulk discount plugin. Create dynamic pricing, volume discounts, wholesale pricing & cart discount rules easily.

Why Choose Our Free WooCommerce Bulk Discount Plugin?

Setting up a robust pricing strategy is crucial for eCommerce success. Our plugin provides an intuitive interface to create flexible, rule-based pricing tiers that automatically apply discounts to individual products or the entire cart. Reward your loyal customers, set up B2B wholesale pricing, or run time-limited promotions with ease.

Key Features for Dynamic Pricing & Volume Discounts

  • Unlimited Discount Rules — Create targeted pricing rules for specific products, categories, or your entire WooCommerce catalog.
  • Volume Pricing & Tiered Discounts — Encourage bulk purchases by setting multiple quantity-based pricing tiers (e.g., buy 1–4 at 10% off, buy 5+ at 20% off).
  • Flexible Pricing Types — Choose between a Fixed Discount (amount subtracted from regular price) or a Percentage Discount for maximum flexibility.
  • Role-Based Pricing — Perfect for B2B stores! Restrict discounts and wholesale pricing to specific WordPress user roles (e.g., Wholesale, VIP, Subscriber).
  • Customer-Specific Discounts — Assign special pricing tiers to individual customer accounts to reward your best buyers.
  • Cart Level Discounts — Apply global discount rules based on the total cart quantity or cart subtotal.
  • Product & Category Restrictions — Include or exclude specific products or categories from your discount rules.
  • Scheduled Promotions — Set start and end dates for your pricing tiers to run automated, time-limited sales campaigns.
  • Beautiful Pricing Tables — Automatically display a clear, conversion-optimized volume pricing table on single product pages.
  • Rule Priority System — easily manage conflicting rules by assigning priorities.
  • Seamless Compatibility — Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.

How It Works: Setup WooCommerce Bulk Discounts in Minutes

  1. Create a Discount Rule: Give your new dynamic pricing rule a name and set its priority.
  2. Select Target Products: Choose whether the rule applies to specific products, categories, or the entire store.
  3. Configure Pricing Tiers: Add minimum/maximum quantity requirements, choose your pricing type (fixed/percentage), and set the discount value.
  4. Target Users (Optional): Restrict the rule to specific user roles or individual customers for targeted promotions.
  5. Watch Sales Grow: The plugin automatically applies the correct discounted price on product pages and in the shopping cart!

Completely Free Plugin

This free plugin provides everything you need to get started, supporting unlimited rules, unlimited tiers, advanced user targeting, and scheduling features to fully supercharge your store’s pricing strategy without any hidden costs.

Configuration & Usage

Step 1: Enable the Plugin

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Discount On Cart.
  2. Click the General Settings tab.
  3. Check Enable Discount Rules to activate the dynamic pricing engine.
  4. Click Save Changes.

Step 2: Create a Discount Rule

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Discount Rules.
  2. Click Add New Discount Rule.
  3. Set your rule title and Priority (lower numbers take precedence).
  4. Check Enable Rule.

Step 3: Set Up Pricing Tiers & User Targeting

  1. Choose your target products/categories in the inclusion/exclusion settings.
  2. Click + Add New Pricing Tier.
  3. Define the Min Qty, Max Qty, Pricing Type, and Discount Value.
  4. Select targeted User Roles or specific Usernames (optional).
  5. Set scheduling dates (optional).
  6. Publish the rule to see it live on your store!
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.4 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for MultiAddons Bulk Product & Cart Discount for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. After installation completes, click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this bulk discount plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required for this dynamic pricing and volume discount plugin to function.

What is the difference between Fixed Price and Percentage discount?

  • Fixed Price: A flat currency amount is subtracted from the product’s regular price (e.g., $5 off).
  • Percentage: A percentage is deducted from the price (e.g., 10% off).

Can I use this for WooCommerce Wholesale Pricing?

Yes! By using our Role-Based Pricing feature, you can easily set up separate wholesale pricing tiers for specific user roles.

Can I create time-limited discounts?

Absolutely. Each pricing tier has optional Start Date and End Date fields for running scheduled promotions.

Will this plugin conflict with WooCommerce sale prices?

No. The plugin uses the product’s regular price as the base for discount calculations, ensuring accurate pricing rules.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, it is 100% compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the new Cart/Checkout Blocks.
